# ADR-009: Own source angular state and reuse unbounded formation arithmetic

Status: chosen_for_angular_formation_batch

Concerns: Q-state, Q-order, Q-behavior, Q-reproduce

## Decision

Keep the nine source scalar fields in existing Bevy metadata and encode their exact f64 bits in snapshots. Generate angular transitions from the reviewed existing specification AST. Reuse only formation arithmetic with the actual world-loaded offsets and original old-orientation rotation kernel, leaving bounded proof-model tables out of production.

## Rationale

Original Ball fields and command/post-motion ordering determine formation behavior. Quaternion reconstruction and internal snapping failed unchanged original traces. Original arithmetic can yield nonfinite angle values, so a finite-only snapshot filter changes its valid state domain.

## Alternatives

Derive source yaw/pitch/roll from quaternion orientation; reset angles on every internal velocity write; reuse bounded model collections as the world.

## Consequences

Original angle and both formation fixtures now pass; exact angular-bit preservation and scoped future replay are tested. Dynamic orientation, collision-history correspondence, complete state closure and formal production refinement remain required.
